source: NASA Exoplanet Archive PS, default_flag=1 except explicit derived axes

queries.composite: select pl_name,hostname,sy_pnum,sy_snum,discoverymethod,pl_orbper,pl_orbpererr1,pl_orbpererr2,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbsmaxerr1,pl_orbsmaxerr2,pl_rade,pl_radeerr1,pl_radeerr2,pl_radelim,pl_bmasse,pl_bmasseerr1,pl_bmasseerr2,pl_bmasselim,pl_bmassprov,pl_orbeccen,pl_orbeccenerr1,pl_orbeccenerr2,st_spectype,st_teff,st_mass from pscomppars where hostname in ('TRAPPIST-1','Kepler-90','Kepler-11','TOI-178','55 Cnc') or pl_name in ('51 Peg b','55 Cnc e','Kepler-16 b','HD 80606 b','WASP-107 b','PSR B1257+12 c')
queries.default: select pl_name,hostname,sy_pnum,sy_snum,discoverymethod,pl_orbper,pl_orbpererr1,pl_orbpererr2,pl_orbsmax,pl_orbsmaxerr1,pl_orbsmaxerr2,pl_rade,pl_radeerr1,pl_radeerr2,pl_radelim,pl_bmasse,pl_bmasseerr1,pl_bmasseerr2,pl_bmasselim,pl_bmassprov,pl_orbeccen,pl_orbeccenerr1,pl_orbeccenerr2,st_spectype,st_teff,st_mass,pl_refname from ps where default_flag=1 and (hostname in ('TRAPPIST-1','Kepler-90','Kepler-11','TOI-178','55 Cnc') or pl_name in ('51 Peg b','55 Cnc e','Kepler-16 b','HD 80606 b','WASP-107 b','PSR B1257+12 c'))

method_notes: Kepler-90 is catalogued as KOI-351; aliases are normalized only for display.
55 Cancri A: five planets of hostname 55 Cnc; archive sy_pnum=7 includes two planets of companion hostname 55 Cnc B.
TOI-178/Kepler-90 axes uniformly derived from selected periods and stellar masses 0.647/1.12 solar; no measured errors implied.
Periods and masses/radii for each unusual planet come from one PS reference, with original errors retained. 51 Peg b: Cont 2026 mass from high-resolution planet spectroscopy, not m sin i.
Solar axes/periods rounded reference values from JPL; planet symbols have constant illustrative sizes.

Kepler-90 uses Cabrera 2014 for seven original planets plus Shallue/Vanderburg 2018 for i, retaining measured radii. Newer default PS entries for g/h provide masses but omit radii; not mixed into the selected physical records.

habitable_band_notes.Slunce: Approximate conservative Kopparapu 2014 band; consistent with batch 14 comparison.
habitable_band_notes.TRAPPIST-1: Published approximate 0.024–0.049 AU interval from batch14; e/f/g marked.
habitable_band_notes.55 Cnc: Published von Braun et al. 2011 band 0.67–1.32 AU; selected f orbit (a=0.802,e=0.063) is within that interval. This is an approximate model region, not evidence for a water-bearing surface of the gas planet.
